title: Breakout Trend Persistence
rationale: Tests whether upside persistence after a rolling-high breakout behaves differently from price-versus-average trend state.
tests_claim: A daily breakout trend rule can participate in persistent upside moves while exiting after a rolling-low failure.
known_limitations: Breakout behavior is still a trend-following mechanism, so it should not be treated as a fresh thesis by itself.
The current campaign-safe mapping does not expose channel lengths as candidate parameters.
